#sia-qgis .footer{margin-top:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}#sia-qgis a{color:var(--teal);font-weight:720}#sia-qgis .footer a{color:var(--teal2)}

<div class="eyebrow">QGIS for Beginners · GIS &amp; Geospatial Analysis</div>
<h1>From geographic data to a publication-ready map</h1>
<p>Demonstrate your understanding of the introductory QGIS lecture, from navigating the interface and loading boundaries to selecting features, joining surveillance data, and exporting maps.</p>
<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><strong>20</strong><span>Multiple-choice questions</span></div><div class="stat"><strong>5</strong><span>Core learning areas</span></div><div class="stat"><strong>80%</strong><span>Pass requirement (16/20)</span></div></div></header>
<section class="panel"><h2>Assessment instructions</h2><p>Answer all <strong>20 questions</strong>. Each question has <strong>one correct response</strong>. Select an option and click <strong>Check answer</strong> to receive immediate feedback. You may revise an answer and check it again.</p>
<div class="notice"><strong>Qualifying standard:</strong> A score of at least <strong>16/20 (80%)</strong>, with <strong>all 20 questions checked</strong>, is required to display the SI Analytics success code. Save the code and submit it according to your course instructions. Your answers are evaluated locally in your browser.</div></section>
<section class="topic"><h2>GIS foundations and navigation</h2><span>Questions 1–4</span></section>
<article class="question" id="sia-q01" data-answer="B" data-checked="false" data-correct="false">
<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 01 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">GIS foundations and navigation</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-1">A public health team wants to identify areas with a high HIV burden to guide case-finding activities. Which use of GIS best matches the lecture?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-1">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-1" value="A"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">A</span><span>Estimating laboratory test sensitivity</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-1" value="B"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span>Mapping geographic hotspots to inform targeting</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-1" value="C"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">C</span><span>Converting patient records into spreadsheets</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-1" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>Calculating confidence intervals for prevalence</span></label>
</div><div class="qactions"><button type="button" class="check">Check answer</button><span class="qstatus" aria-live="polite">Not checked</span></div>
<div class="qfeedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-explanation="The instructor described hotspot mapping as a way to locate areas of high HIV burden and help inform case finding."></div></article>
<article class="question" id="sia-q02" data-answer="D" data-checked="false" data-correct="false">
<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 02 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">GIS foundations and navigation</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-2">Which description of QGIS was given in the introduction?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-2">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-2" value="A"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">A</span><span>Paid software restricted to Windows</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-2" value="B"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span>A browser-only service requiring a subscription</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-2" value="C"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">C</span><span>A proprietary tool available only on macOS</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-2" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>Free, open-source GIS software available on Windows, macOS, and Linux</span></label>
</div><div class="qactions"><button type="button" class="check">Check answer</button><span class="qstatus" aria-live="polite">Not checked</span></div>
<div class="qfeedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-explanation="QGIS was introduced as free and open-source, community-developed software that runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux."></div></article>
<article class="question" id="sia-q03" data-answer="A" data-checked="false" data-correct="false">
<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 03 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">GIS foundations and navigation</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-3">After the instructor saved an untitled QGIS project as “Mentor Class,” what changed in the interface?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-3">

<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-3" value="B"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span>The coordinate system in the status bar</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-3" value="C"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">C</span><span>The country boundaries in the map canvas</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-3" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>The file extension of every loaded layer</span></label>
</div><div class="qactions"><button type="button" class="check">Check answer</button><span class="qstatus" aria-live="polite">Not checked</span></div>

<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 04 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">GIS foundations and navigation</span></div>

<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 05 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">Loading geographic boundaries</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-5">Which part of the QGIS interface contains drop-down menus such as Project, Edit, View, and Layer?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-5">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-5" value="A"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">A</span><span>The standard toolbar</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-5" value="B"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span>The menu bar</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-5" value="C"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">C</span><span>The map canvas</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-5" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>The status bar</span></label>
</div><div class="qactions"><button type="button" class="check">Check answer</button><span class="qstatus" aria-live="polite">Not checked</span></div>
<div class="qfeedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-explanation="The instructor called this row of hierarchical menus the menu bar."></div></article>
<article class="question" id="sia-q06" data-answer="A" data-checked="false" data-correct="false">
<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 06 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">Loading geographic boundaries</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-6">In the demonstration, which menu sequence was used to load a country boundary shapefile?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-6">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-6" value="A"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">A</span><span>Layer → Add Layer → Add Vector Layer</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-6" value="B"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span>Project → New Print Layout → Add Map</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-6" value="C"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">C</span><span>View → Panels → Browser</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-6" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>Layer → Properties → Labels</span></label>
</div><div class="qactions"><button type="button" class="check">Check answer</button><span class="qstatus" aria-live="polite">Not checked</span></div>
<div class="qfeedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-explanation="The instructor navigated from Layer to Add Layer and then Add Vector Layer to browse to the shapefile."></div></article>
<article class="question" id="sia-q07" data-answer="D" data-checked="false" data-correct="false">
<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 07 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">Loading geographic boundaries</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-7">A learner has downloaded a zipped collection of country shapefiles but only opens the ZIP archive. What did the instructor ask them to do before browsing for the file?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-7">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-7" value="A"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">A</span><span>Rename the ZIP file to a PDF</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-7" value="B"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span>Import the ZIP as a delimited text file</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-7" value="C"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">C</span><span>Delete all metadata associated with the ZIP</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-7" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>Extract (unzip) its contents to a known folder</span></label>
</div><div class="qactions"><button type="button" class="check">Check answer</button><span class="qstatus" aria-live="polite">Not checked</span></div>
<div class="qfeedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-explanation="The instructor distinguished opening an archive from extracting it and instructed the learner to unzip the shapefiles to a known location."></div></article>

<div class="qmeta"><span class="qnum">QUESTION 08 / 20</span><span class="qtopic">Loading geographic boundaries</span></div>
<div class="stem" id="stem-8">For the Nigeria boundary data used in the lecture, which administrative level pairing was explained?</div><div class="choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="stem-8">

<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="sia-answer-8" value="D"><span class="letter" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span>Admin 1: local government area; Admin 2: country</span></label>

<article class="question" id="sia-q09" data-answer="B" data-checked="false" data-correct="false">

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const quiz = document.getElementById('sia-qgis');
  if (!quiz) return;
  const questions = Array.from(quiz.querySelectorAll('.question'));
  const TOTAL = questions.length;
  const PASS_MARK = 16;
  const SUCCESS_CODE = 'QGIS2026SIA';
  const scoreEl = quiz.querySelector('#sia-score');
  const checkedEl = quiz.querySelector('#sia-checked-count');
  const messageEl = quiz.querySelector('#sia-score-message');
  const fillEl = quiz.querySelector('#sia-progress-fill');
  const progressEl = quiz.querySelector('.progress');
  const panelEl = quiz.querySelector('#sia-code-panel');
  const codeEl = quiz.querySelector('#sia-success-code');
  function updateScore(){
    const correct = questions.filter(q=>q.dataset.correct==='true').length;
    const checked = questions.filter(q=>q.dataset.checked==='true').length;
    const percent = Math.round(correct*100/TOTAL);
    scoreEl.textContent = correct+' / '+TOTAL+' correct ('+percent+'%)';
    checkedEl.textContent = checked+' of '+TOTAL+' checked';
    fillEl.style.width = percent+'%';
    progressEl.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(percent));
    const passed = (checked===TOTAL && correct>=PASS_MARK);
    panelEl.style.display = passed ? 'block' : 'none';
    if(passed){
      codeEl.textContent = SUCCESS_CODE;
      messageEl.textContent = 'Congratulations. You achieved the 80% qualifying standard.';
    }else if(checked<TOTAL){
      messageEl.textContent = 'Check '+(TOTAL-checked)+' remaining question'+(TOTAL-checked===1?'':'s')+' to complete the assessment.';
    }else{
      messageEl.textContent = 'You need '+(PASS_MARK-correct)+' additional correct answer'+(PASS_MARK-correct===1?'':'s')+' to pass. Review your feedback, revise, and check again.';
    }
  }
  function clearMarks(card){
    card.dataset.checked = 'false';
    card.dataset.correct = 'false';
    card.querySelectorAll('label.choice').forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('correct-answer','wrong-answer'));
    const feedback=card.querySelector('.qfeedback');
    feedback.textContent='';
    feedback.className='qfeedback';
    card.querySelector('.qstatus').textContent='Not checked';
  }
  questions.forEach((card)=>{
    const button=card.querySelector('button.check');
    const radios=card.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]');
    radios.forEach(radio=>radio.addEventListener('change',()=>{clearMarks(card);updateScore();}));
    button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const selected=card.querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');
      const status=card.querySelector('.qstatus');
      if(!selected){status.textContent='Choose an option first.';return;}
      clearMarks(card);
      const answer=card.dataset.answer;
      const correct=selected.value===answer;
      card.dataset.checked='true';
      card.dataset.correct=String(correct);
      radios.forEach(radio=>{
        const label=radio.closest('label.choice');
        if(radio.value===answer) label.classList.add('correct-answer');
        else if(radio.checked) label.classList.add('wrong-answer');
      });
      const explanation=card.querySelector('.qfeedback');
      explanation.classList.add(correct?'good':'bad');
      explanation.textContent=(correct?'Correct. ':'Not quite. ')+explanation.dataset.explanation;
      status.textContent=correct?'Correct answer':'Review and try again';
      updateScore();
    });
  });
  quiz.querySelector('#sia-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(!window.confirm('Reset all 20 responses and your current score?'))return;
    questions.forEach(card=>{
      card.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(input=>input.checked=false);
      clearMarks(card);
    });
    quiz.querySelector('#sia-copy-status').textContent='';
    updateScore();
    quiz.querySelector('.hero').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  });
  quiz.querySelector('#sia-copy-code').addEventListener('click', async()=>{
    if(panelEl.style.display!=='block')return;
    const status=quiz.querySelector('#sia-copy-status');
    try{
      if(navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext){
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(SUCCESS_CODE);
      }else{
        const temp=document.createElement('textarea');temp.value=SUCCESS_CODE;
        temp.style.position='fixed';temp.style.opacity='0';document.body.appendChild(temp);
        temp.focus();temp.select();
        const copied=document.execCommand('copy');temp.remove();
        if(!copied)throw Error('Clipboard not available');
      }
      status.textContent='Success code copied.';
    }catch(e){status.textContent='Select the code above to copy it manually.';}
  });
  updateScore();
})();
</script>
